articles.title: National CineMedia Launches 2026 US Young Lions Competition

articles.summary: National CineMedia announced Save The Music Foundation as the official non-profit partner for the 2026 US Young Lions Competition. The organization is featured in the 2026 competition brief, inviting registered advertising, marketing, and communications professionals to develop creative ideas that support the foundation’s mission. Winning teams will travel as TEAM USA to the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity.
articles.title: National CineMedia Announces Save The Music Foundation as Official Non-Profit Partner of the 2026 Cannes Lions Young Lions Competition
